push notification.definition: A notification delivered to the device through Apple/Google push services when the app is in the background.

notification sound.definition: The audio played when a notification or incoming call arrives; selectable in mobile settings.

share extension.definition: The OS-level sharing feature that lets users send content from other apps into Mattermost.

bottom sheet.definition: A panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen showing options or details.

swipe.definition: A touch gesture of sliding a finger across the screen, e.g. to dismiss or reveal actions.

long-press.definition: A touch gesture of pressing and holding an item to open its options menu.

tap.definition: A touch gesture of briefly touching the screen to select or activate something.

toast.definition: A small temporary message that appears briefly on screen to confirm an action.

clipboard.definition: The device's temporary storage for copied text or links ('copied to clipboard').

biometrics.definition: Fingerprint or face-based device authentication used to protect access to the app.

passcode.definition: The device's numeric lock code, which can be required to open the app.

screen lock.definition: The device security setting that must be enabled when app protection is required.

jailbroken.definition: Describes a device with OS security protections removed (rooted on Android); such devices can be blocked by policy.

app logs.definition: Diagnostic log files generated by the mobile app that users can download or attach to problem reports.

EMM.definition: Abbreviation for Enterprise Mobility Management, the corporate device-management systems the app integrates with.

Face ID.definition: Apple's face-recognition authentication; platform brand name.

tablet.definition: A large-screen device on which the app uses a split, two-pane layout.

deep link.definition: A URL that opens a specific screen, channel, or message directly in the mobile app.

skin tone.definition: The selectable skin color variant for people emojis.

playback speed.definition: The speed setting for playing voice messages and videos.

server connection.definition: A Mattermost server added to the mobile app; the app supports connecting to and switching between multiple servers.
